summary: Loads static camera scene data. Initializes a stack-scratch transform array (128 entries, stride 160) and a small stream-state struct, searches the game-wide string table for "MainView" and stores the hit at this+0x4 if found, then opens the audio stream wrapper for file a2. On success it reads up to 128 "StaticCam"-matching entries via a dispatch loop, allocates a persistent array of 160*v6+4 bytes, initializes v6 entries, stores the array at this+0xC and the count at this+0x10 (and resets this+0x14 to 0), then copies the loaded scratch entries into the allocated storage. Both success and failure paths run a 128-entry stack cleanup (stride 40) and release the stream struct. Returns 0 on load success, 1 on skip/failure.

operations.description: ZeroInitSmallStruct(v21) initializes the small stream/state struct used by the file helpers.
Local state init: v3=0 (success result), v28[384] zeroed via memset, stack struct fields v23/v25/v26/v27 = 0 and v24 = 1.
Initialize 128 temporary transform entries on the stack scratch buffer v30 (stride 160 each) via F_3DTransformObjectInit.
If the "MainView" search result v7 is nonzero, store it into this[1] (this+0x4).
If AudioStreamOpen(a2, 1) returns zero the load is aborted: run the stack cleanup loop, call SubCallWithConditionalFieldFree(v21) and return 1.

Entry-read loop while ConditionalDispatchBasedOnFlag(v28, 384) stays nonzero: if !sub_5651B0(v22) and sub_565520(aStaticcam, v29, 0) matches a "StaticCam" entry and v6 < 128, call sub_4572B0(v21, v29) to consume it, increment count v6 and advance the scratch pointer by 160.
If the initial ConditionalDispatchBasedOnFlag(v28, 384) check fails, or no entries were read (v6 == 0), take the skip path (LABEL_27) and set result v3 = 1.
Computed allocation size = 160 * v6 + 4 (v6 loaded entries at stride 160 plus a count word).
OperatorNewNhMallocWrapper(160 * v6 + 4) allocates the persistent camera-entry array.
If allocation succeeded: the first word of the allocation is set to the count v6 (header), and v6 entries starting at v12+1 are initialized with stride 40 via F_3DTransformObjectInit.
If the allocation failed, the stored array pointer v15 is set to 0; otherwise it points at the initialized entry payload (v12+1).
Persist load result on the instance: this[3] = array pointer, this[4] = entry count v6, this[5] = 0 (reset current index).
Copy the loaded scratch entries (stride 160) into the allocation with F_2DTransformStructCopy for v16 in 0..this[4]-1.
ConditionalFileHandleCloseWithFlagDispatch(v21) closes the underlying file handle after the read loop.
Cleanup loop: for 128 iterations call ShortComputation_62a0 on consecutive stack frames stepping back by 40 bytes from the saved return-address area.
SubCallWithConditionalFieldFree(v21) releases the stream-state struct before returning.
Return v3 (0 success, 1 skip/failure); the audio-open-failure branch returns 1 directly.
